title: 5.2.1 Bouncy Ball
description: Learn how bounciness and friction change how sprites feel.

steps.title: Build a box with four walls
steps.instructions: Four static sprites — top, bottom, left, right — make a containment box.
hints: Re-use the same size; just change positions and rotations.

steps.title: Add a ball
steps.instructions: Create a dynamic sprite with a `diameter` (e.g. 30) — that makes it a circle collider instead of a rectangle.
hints: new Sprite(200, 100, 30) — one size argument = circle.

steps.title: Tune bounciness
steps.instructions: Set `ball.bounciness = 1`. Values above 0.9 make it bounce nearly forever; 0 means it sticks.

steps.title: Try friction
steps.instructions: Give the ball `ball.friction = 0`. Then try `ball.friction = 5`. Notice how it rolls vs. drags.
